tasks.title: ADR-0088 and the plugin editor service interface (contract only)
tasks.brief: The host side of editors is on main (#322, #339: plugins/host editor_x11.cpp, HostControl OpenEditor/EditorOpened/EditorFailed/EditorClosed, HostSupervisor tracks open_editors_). Nothing lets the UI open one. This feature is the CONTRACT PR only: engine wiring and UI are a follow-up feature (plugins.host.editors.wire) planned after interchange.stems merges, because they must edit engine/control/CMakeLists.txt, engine_control_server.cpp and contracts/api/CMakeLists.txt, which interchange.stems owns. Write brain/decisions/ADR-0088-plugin-editor-launch.md (its INDEX line goes in the PR description, not the INDEX file). Decide: (1) the UI asks the engine, the engine asks the host; the UI never talks to a host; (2) one editor per insert, a second request raises the existing window; (3) states Closed, Opening, Open, Failed(reason from EditorFailed); an editor that cannot open (no DISPLAY, LV2 UI, host without X11) shows the reason and the UI offers the generic editor, never a blank window; (4) parent token empty on appliance and WSLg (parentless toplevel); (5) the editor lives and dies with the host: host crash or chain removal reports Closed; (6) values moved in the editor reach the document through the existing ParamTouched/gesture path, no new value path; (7) wire for the follow-up: commands OpenPluginEditor{track,slot}, ClosePluginEditor{track,slot}, state event PluginEditorState{track,slot,state,reason}; protocol number reserved by the coordinator when it dispatches the follow-up, this PR carries no wire. Rejected: embedding the plugin window in Qt (X11 reparenting under Wayland labwc is fragile, ADR-0010); generic editor only; polling plugin state. Unverified: behaviour under WSLg and labwc (researcher measures). Code: new module engine/editor_service with its own CMakeLists.txt, header-only INTERFACE library sonora_editor_service, std only: include/sonora/editor_service/plugin_editor_service.h with enum class EditorState{Closed,Opening,Open,Failed}; struct EditorStatus{state, reason}; interface PluginEditorService{open(track,slot)->EditorStatus; close(track,slot); status(track,slot)->EditorStatus; set_listener(...)}; inline FakePluginEditorService; tests/test_plugin_editor_service.cpp (open twice raises, not duplicates; failed carries reason; close of closed ignored; host-stop reports Closed). Register in root CMakeLists.txt: add_subdirectory(engine/editor_service) and sonora_label_module_tests(engine/editor_service control).
accept: ADR-0088 has Context, Decision, Rationale, Consequences, Alternatives rejected
the contract test builds and passes under tools/micro-build.sh
tools/pre-pr.sh reports no ADR number clash
